answer.says: Ramesh, the spirit does not make the rice, but the body requires it. I have only one hundred and sixty-six rupees. Use it for the groceries: rice, lentils, and whatever is necessary for a simple meal. I will settle the debt when the file returns from orders. Sit down and drink the chai; I will eat what you provide.
answer.thought: The system of needs is absolute; the spirit cannot subsist on abstract freedom when the stomach demands grain. I have no choice but to subordinate my pride to the immediate necessity of the body, spending my last cash on the very materiality that grounds my existence. It is a humiliation, but a necessary one.
